STUDYQURAN:39:intro/r11.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:intro/r11.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:intro/r11.claim: The death passage shows disbelievers’ desperate end; verse 53 then emphasizes that God’s mercy and forgiveness remain available even to those who squandered their souls.
STUDYQURAN:39:intro/r11.anchor: A passage on death emphasizes the desperate circumstances of those who disbelieve when they meet their final end

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p522/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p522/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p522/r2.claim: The arrogant attribute God-given wealth and status to their own planning, though earlier people held the same delusion and were seized without their plans helping them.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p522/r2.anchor: they think that the wealth and status which God has bestowed upon them is the result of their own planning

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r2.claim: The author instead links the severe, unexpected punishment to the following portrait of wrongdoers invoking God in distress but denying His gift, then facing the consequences.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r2.anchor: والذي يظهر في الربط أنه لما قال: ولو أن للذين ظلموا الآية، كان ذلك إشعارا بما ينال الظالمين من شدة العذاب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r3.claim: Most people fail to know that prosperity is a gradual enticement and a test.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r3.anchor: ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون: أي أن ذلك استدراج وامتحان.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r4.claim: Earlier unbelievers made the same boast; Qarun is an example, and the plural may ascribe the statement to Qarun's people who accepted it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r4.anchor: والظاهر أن قائلي ذلك جماعة من الأمم الكافرة الماضية، كقارون في قوله: قال إنما أوتيته على علم عندي . وقيل: الذين من قبلهم هم قارون وقومه

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r5.claim: A reading with a masculine pronoun in قد قاله takes its suffix to mean the saying or speech.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p210#2/r5.anchor: وقرىء: قد قاله، أي قال القول أو الكلام.

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r1.speaker: غير مذكور في المقطع
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r1.claim: An unattributed report fragment says a phrase would dispel the two men's anger: seeking refuge in God from the accursed Satan.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r1.anchor: إني لأعلم كلمة لو قالاها لذهب عنهما ذلك وهي قوله

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r2.claim: Anger disrupts the little reason by which people know the world's benefits and harms; recalling this restrains bad words and deeds and turns one to God for good and protection.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r2.anchor: الإنسان يعلم أن علمه بمصالح هذا العالم ومفاسده قليل جدا وأنه إنما يمكنه أن يعرف ذلك القليل بمدد العقل

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r3.claim: Since a person cannot be sure whether he or his opponent is right, he should entrust the dispute to God: if he is right God can secure his due, and if wrong he should not oppress the other.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r3.anchor: الإنسان غير عالم قطعا بأن الحق من جانبه ولا من جانب خصمه فإذا علم ذلك يقول : أفوض هذه الواقعة إلى الله تعالى

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r4.claim: The angry person should remember that God is stronger, yet repeatedly pardons his own disobedience; this should prompt him to forgive the person who angered him and stop disputing.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r4.anchor: إله العالم أقوى وأقدر مني ثم إني عصيته مرات وكرات وأنه بفضله تجاوز عني فالأولى لي أن أتجاوز عن هذا المغضوب عليه

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r5.claim: Al-Razi derives these reflections from the verse about the God-conscious remembering God when touched by a satanic impulse and then seeing clearly: remembering restores right judgment and ends dispute.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r5.anchor: كل هذه المعاني مستنبطة من قوله تعالى : ﴿ إن الذين اتقوا إذا مسهم طائف من الشيطان تذكروا فإذا هم مبصرون ﴾

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r6.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r6.claim: The Prophet says that reciting refuge three times morning or evening together with the last three verses of al-Hashr brings seventy thousand angels praying for the reciter until the opposite time; dying that day brings martyr status. No grading is given.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r6.anchor: روى معقل بن يسار رضي الله عنه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال من قال حين يصبح ثلاث مرات

RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r7.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r7.claim: Al-Razi explains the practice rationally: seeking refuge witnesses the self's utter weakness, while the last three verses of al-Hashr witness God's perfection and grandeur; full servanthood requires both.
RAZI-FULL:v1p68/r7.anchor: وتقريره من جانب العقل أن قوله : { أعوذ بالله } مشاهدة لكمال عجز النفس وغاية قصورها والآيات الثلاث من آخر سورة الحشر مشاهدة لكمال الله

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r1.claim: The earlier people repeated the claim from 39:49 that they received blessings because of knowledge, like Korah in 28:78.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r1.anchor: The same refers to the statement I was only given it because of knowledge in v. 49

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r2.claim: Korah, described as a wealthy member of Pharaoh’s court, makes a similar claim in 28:78.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r2.anchor: Korah, a wealthy member of Pharaoh’s court, says in 28:78

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r3.claim: What those earlier people earned did not help them in this life or the Hereafter.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r3.anchor: in this life and the Hereafter that which they used to earn availed them not (cf. 15:84; 40:82)

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r4.claim: The particle mā can be read negatively, yielding the translation that their earnings did not avail them.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r4.anchor: here rendered as a negative particle

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r5.speaker: Q
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r5.claim: If mā is interrogative rather than negative, the phrase asks how their earnings could have helped them.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r5.anchor: it would then read, “Then in what way did that which they used to earn avail them?” (Q)

STUDYQURAN:39:50/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r6.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r6.claim: Both readings stress the fragility and ephemerality of worldly pursuits before God reveals what people did not reckon with and wealth and children fail to help, except for a sound heart.
STUDYQURAN:39:50/r6.anchor: Both renderings indicate the frailty and ephemerality of the things that consume people in this life

BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r2.claim: The feminine pronoun in قالها refers to that utterance, namely the claim “I was given it on account of knowledge.”

BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r3.claim: Bursevi identifies Qarun and his people: Qarun claimed knowledge of his own worth, and his people approved his claim, so both are included.
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r3.anchor: وهم قارون وقومه حيث قال : إنما أوتيته على علم عندي

BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r4.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r4.claim: Some allow that the phrase includes any earlier people, good or evil, who became arrogant and deceived by outward prosperity, not Qarun alone.
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r4.anchor: وقال بعضهم : يجوز أن يكون جميع من تقدمنا من الخيار والشرار

BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r5.claim: Their worldly possessions did not avert punishment or torment and were of no use to them.
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r5.anchor: أن النعمة لم تدفع عنهم النقمة والعذاب

BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p91#4/r6.claim: The author cites Al-Mufradat that aghna anhu means to suffice or be enough for someone.

TAB-FULL:v1p27/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r1.claim: After Umar challenged a man’s recitation, the Prophet confirmed he had taught it, expelled Satan from Umar three times, and said readings are correct unless mercy and punishment are reversed.
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r1.anchor: فقال: يا رسول الله، ألم تقرئني آية كذا وكذا؟ قال: «بلى»

TAB-FULL:v1p27/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r2.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that when Umar brought a man reciting differently, the Prophet said the Qur’an was revealed in seven sufficient, sound forms.
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r2.anchor: فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: «أنزل القرآن على سبعة أحرف، كلها شاف كاف»

TAB-FULL:v1p27/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r3.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r3.claim: Ibn Masʿūd said not to quarrel over readings: they do not contradict one another, and Islamic law, limits, and duties remain one; the Prophet confirmed all companions reciting to him were correct.
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r3.anchor: لما خرج عبد الله بن مسعود من الكوفة، اجتمع إليه أصحابه فودعهم، ثم قال: «لا تنازعوا في القرآن

TAB-FULL:v1p27/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r4.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r4.claim: Ibn Masʿūd said he learned seventy sūrahs from the Prophet, would seek anyone more knowledgeable, and reviewed the Qur’an with him each Ramadan, twice in the final year; the Prophet affirmed his recitation.
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r4.anchor: عن زبيد، عن علقمة النخعي، قال: لما خرج عبد الله بن مسعود من الكوفة

TAB-FULL:v1p27/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r5.speaker: عبد الله بن مسعود
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r5.claim: Ibn Masʿūd urged readers not to abandon his reading or another authorized form out of disdain, since rejecting one verse amounts to rejecting the whole Qur’an.
TAB-FULL:v1p27/r5.anchor: عن زبيد، عن علقمة النخعي، قال: لما خرج عبد الله بن مسعود من الكوفة

TABATABAI:39:49-52/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r5.claim: The pronoun in “they said it” returns to the preceding statement, treating it as a saying or utterance.
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r5.anchor: راجع إلى القول السابق باعتبار أنه مقالة أو كلمة

TABATABAI:39:49-52/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r6.claim: The verse refutes the boast by showing that if people earned bounty by their own power, their effort would preserve it and benefit them, yet their predecessors’ deeds did not save them from ruin.
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r6.anchor: والآية رد لقولهم وإثبات لكونها فتنة يمتحنون بها

TABATABAI:39:49-52/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:39:49-52/r7.claim: The predecessors who made this boast likely include Qarun, whose story in 28:78 records the same claim.

TABRISI:39:46-50/r23.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:39:46-50/r23.speaker: author
TABRISI:39:46-50/r23.claim: People before them made the same boast; Qarun is an example, saying he received his wealth through knowledge of his own.
TABRISI:39:46-50/r23.anchor: أي قد قال مثل هذه الكلمة وهذه المقالة

TABRISI:39:46-50/r24.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:39:46-50/r24.speaker: author
TABRISI:39:46-50/r24.claim: Their amassed wealth did not help them and instead became a burden against them.
TABRISI:39:46-50/r24.anchor: أي فلم ينفعهم ما كانوا يجمعونه من الأموال بل صارت وبالا عليهم

THALABI:v8p240/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p240/r8.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p240/r8.claim: The earlier person who made this boast was Qarun, who said he had received his wealth through his own knowledge.
THALABI:v8p240/r8.anchor: قد قالها الذين من قبلهم يعني: قارون إذ قال إنما أوتيته على علم عندي.

THALABI:v8p240/r9.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v8p240/r9.speaker: author
THALABI:v8p240/r9.claim: Their earnings did not protect them; the evil consequences of their deeds overtook them.
THALABI:v8p240/r9.anchor: فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون فأصابهم سيئات ما كسبوا

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:39:49-50/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:39:49-50/r3.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:39:49-50/r3.claim: The earlier person who made this boast was Qarun, who said he had received his wealth through his own knowledge.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:39:49-50/r3.anchor: يعني: قارون حين قال: إنما أوتيته على علم عندي

ELMALILI:39:42-52/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:39:42-52/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:39:42-52/r2.claim: He renders the claim as one made by earlier people too, whose earnings did not save them.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r1.claim: The passage criticizes blaming God for adversity while claiming blessings for oneself; earlier deniers and the pagan Arabs addressed as “these” in verse 51 acted this way and will suffer for their own evil acquisitions.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r1.anchor: Kötülüğü Allah’a nisbet ederken nimeti, iyiliği kendinden bilme tarzındaki yanlış telakki eleştirilmekte; gerek eski inkârcı toplulukların gerekse 51. âyette “bunlar” şeklinde kendilerine işaret edilen putperest Araplar’ın bu telakkiye göre davrandıkları

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r2.claim: Good and bad events occur only by God’s permission and will, so both good and evil ultimately come from God; human acts shaped by intention and choice are a person’s own acquisition, with consequences proportionate to responsibility.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:39:49/r2.anchor: Aslında Allah’ın izni ve iradesi olmadan evrende hiçbir olay gerçekleşmediği gibi insanlar da herhangi bir iyi veya kötü durumla karşılaşmazlar. Bu açıdan iyilik de kötülük de Allah’tandır (bk. en-Nisâ 4/78).

BAQILLANI:v1p210/r1.author: al-Bāqillānī
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r1.speaker: author
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r1.claim: A compact passage relates the story's meaning in only a few verses while yielding many lessons that would otherwise require lengthy explanation.
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r1.anchor: في ثلاث آيات بعد ذلك معنى هذه القصة التي كانت لهم بكلمات قليلة في العدد كثيرة الفوائد

BAQILLANI:v1p210/r2.author: al-Bāqillānī
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r2.speaker: author
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r2.claim: The warning moves gradually into the reminder that good and evil actions return to their doer, then into hope of mercy; these transitions preserve the discourse's order.
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r2.anchor: ثم لم يخل تضاعيف الكلام مما ترى من الموعظة على أعجب تدريج وأبدع تأريخ

BAQILLANI:v1p210/r3.author: al-Bāqillānī
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r3.speaker: author
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r3.claim: The discourse stays connected while shifting topics, so inserting unrelated material would disrupt its seamless order; its exploration keeps yielding further benefits and wisdom.
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r3.anchor: ولم ينقطع بذلك نظام الكلام وأنت ترى الكلام يتبدد مع اتصاله وينتشر مع انتظامه

BAQILLANI:v1p210/r4.author: al-Bāqillānī
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r4.speaker: author
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r4.claim: Bāqillānī calls those who compare the Qur'an with Imruʾ al-Qays's poetry profoundly foolish, arguing that the poet's work contains obscure, coarse, and inept lines.
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r4.anchor: إن الذي عارض القرآن بشعر امرئ القيس لأضل من حمار باهلة وأحمق من هبنقة

BAQILLANI:v1p210/r5.author: al-Bāqillānī
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r5.speaker: الأصمعي
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r5.claim: Al-Aṣmaʿī admitted he could not identify the meanings of the words san, sannaq, and sanam; another gloss took sannaq to mean a hill.
BAQILLANI:v1p210/r5.anchor: قال الأصمعي لا أدري ما السن ولا السنيق ولا السنم وقال بعضهم السنيق أكمة

BURHAN:v1p18/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p18/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p18/r1.claim: One classification says the Qur’an contains command, prohibition, report, and question; another lists the Sunna and adds promise and threat.
BURHAN:v1p18/r1.anchor: وقال غيره القرآن يشتمل على أربعة أنواع من العلوم أمر ونهى وخبر واستخبار

BURHAN:v1p18/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p18/r3.speaker: علي بن عيسى
BURHAN:v1p18/r3.claim: Ali b. Isa enumerates thirty kinds of Qur’anic content, including warnings, commands, descriptions of Paradise and Hell, divine attributes and favors, argument, moral contrasts, wisdom, praise of the righteous, and blame of the wicked.
BURHAN:v1p18/r3.anchor: وقال على بن عيسى القرآن يشتمل على ثلاثين شيئا الإعلام والتنبيه والأمر والنهى

BURHAN:v1p18/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p18/r4.speaker: القاضي أبو المعالي
BURHAN:v1p18/r4.claim: Abu al-Maʿali says al-Tabari’s three categories encompass the thirty and more; Qur’anic wonders cannot be exhausted, as the verse about God’s keys of the unseen indicates.
BURHAN:v1p18/r4.anchor: قال القاضى أبو المعالى عزيزى وعلى التحقيق أن تلك الثلاثة التى قالها محمد بن جرير تشمل هذه كلها

BURHAN:v1p18/r5.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p18/r5.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p18/r5.claim: Another classification of Qur’anic word sciences has four: iʿrab, nazm, morphology, and iʿtibar, which serves as the measure of the first three and enables inference.
BURHAN:v1p18/r5.anchor: وقال غيره علوم ألفاظ القرآن أربعة الإعراب وهو فى الخبر والنظم وهوالقصد

BURHAN:v1p18/r7.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p18/r7.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p18/r7.claim: Morphology distinguishes related word forms such as أقسط (act justly) and قسط (act unjustly), and بعد (be distant) versus بعد (perish).
BURHAN:v1p18/r7.anchor: والتصريف فى الكلمة كأقسط عدل وقسط جار وبعد ضد قرب وبعد هلك

BURHAN:v3p40/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p40/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p40/r3.claim: Oaths are especially apt when answering denial.

ITQAN:v4p412#3/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r1.speaker: عرباض بن سارية
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r1.claim: The Prophet reportedly recited the Musabbihat before sleep each night and said they contain a verse better than a thousand; Ibn Kathir identifies it as 57:3.
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r1.anchor: أخرج أحمد وأبو داود والترمذي والنسائي عن عرباض بن سارية أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يقرأ المسبحات كل ليلة

ITQAN:v4p412#3/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r2.speaker: أنس
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r2.claim: Ibn al-Sunni reports that the Prophet advised reciting Surat al-Hashr before bed, promising martyrdom if the man died.
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r2.anchor: وقد أخرج ابن السني عن أنس أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أوصى رجلا إذ أتى مضجعه أن يقرأ سورة الحشر

ITQAN:v4p412#3/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r3.speaker: معقل بن يسار
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r3.claim: Al-Tirmidhi reports reciting al-Hashr’s last three verses morning or evening brings seventy thousand angels’ prayers; dying in that period brings martyrdom.
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r3.anchor: وأخرج الترمذي من حديث معقل بن يسار

ITQAN:v4p412#3/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r4.speaker: أبو أمامة
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r4.claim: Al-Bayhaqi reports that whoever recites al-Hashr’s closing verses by night or day and dies then is promised Paradise.
ITQAN:v4p412#3/r4.anchor: وأخرج البيهقي من حديث أبي أمامة

ITQAN:v4p470/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p470/r4.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p470/r4.claim: Multiple valid interpretations can reflect repeated revelation, shared wording intended in both senses, or a general term; sound reports need not conflict.
ITQAN:v4p470/r4.anchor: فالأول إما لكون الآية نزلت مرتين فأريد بها هذا تارة وهذا تارة وإما لكون اللفظ المشترك يجوز أن يراد به معنياه

ITQAN:v4p470/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p470/r6.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p470/r6.claim: Tafsir disagreements are either based only on transmission or knowable otherwise; some reports can be judged sound and others cannot.
ITQAN:v4p470/r6.anchor: والاختلاف في التفسير على نوعين منه ما مستنده النقل فقط ومنه ما يعلم بغير ذلك والمنقول إما عن المعصوم أو غيره

ITQAN:v4p470/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p470/r8.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p470/r8.claim: Accept sound reports from the Prophet; for details from People of the Book such as Ka‘b or Wahb, withhold belief and denial.
ITQAN:v4p470/r8.anchor: فما كان منه منقولا نقلا صحيحا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قبل وما لا بأن نقل عن أهل الكتاب ككعب ووهب وقف عن تصديقه وتكذيبه

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r1.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r1.claim: Jurjani calls the image of dawn slapping a horse’s brow and being avenged in its belly more skillfully and tightly crafted than the preceding example.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r1.anchor: وأحسن من هذا واحكم صنعة قوله في قطعة أخرى

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r2.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r2.claim: The chain image works by extending a familiar comparison between ripples on water and armor rings into chains carried by the current.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r2.anchor: فسبق العرف بتشبيه الحبك على صفحات الغدران بحلق الدروع فتدرج من ذلك إلى أن جعلها سلاسل

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r3.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r3.claim: The conceit fits because extreme speed is associated with madness, while measured slowness and deliberation suggest reason.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r3.anchor: أن شدة الحركة وفرط سرعتها من صفات الجنون كما أن التمهل فيها والتأنى من أوصاف العقل

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r4.speaker: ابن المعتز
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r4.claim: Ibn al-Muʿtazz imagines a sword trembling from fear of the praised warrior, inventing a cause for its shaking in the warrior’s awe.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r4.anchor: ومن هذا الجنس قول ابن المعتز

JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Qāhir al-Jurjānī
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r5.speaker: author
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r5.claim: Jurjani conjectures that Ibn Babak borrowed the sword’s trembling image from Ibn al-Muʿtazz’s verse.
JURJANI-ASRAR:v1p249/r5.anchor: ويشبه أن يكون ابن بابك نظر إلى هذا البيت وعلق منه الرعدة

NAHHAS:v4p15/r6.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p15/r6.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p15/r6.claim: The feminine pronoun agrees with the feminine noun الكلمة.

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r1.claim: قد قالها means that they uttered the previously mentioned statement.
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r1.anchor: قد قالها }: أي: قال القولة المذكورة.

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r2.claim: A variant reads قد قاله, with the masculine pronoun referring to this saying or speech.
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r2.anchor: وقرئ " قد قاله " أي: هذا القول أو الكلام.

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhshari explains the fa here as causal: after they recoil at God's mention and rejoice at their idols, one of them is afflicted and calls on God; the sūra's opening uses wa because it is not causal.

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r4.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r4.claim: The Sheikh rejects al-Zamakhshari's causal linkage because Abu Ali disallows an interruption by two clauses, especially the many clauses here.
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r4.anchor: واستبعده الشيخ من حيث إن أبا علي يمنع الاعتراض بجملتين فكيف بهذه الجمل الكثيرة؟

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r5.speaker: الشيخ
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r5.claim: The Sheikh instead connects the passage to the threatened punishment in 39:47: the wrongdoers' ingratitude is shown by calling on God in harm but not crediting Him for blessings.
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r5.anchor: والذي يظهر في الربط أنه لما قال:

SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r6.claim: ما أغنى may be a direct negation or an interrogative interpreted as negation; the author prefers direct negation to avoid figurative interpretation.
SAMIN-DURR:39:50/r6.anchor: يجوز أن تكون " ما " نافية أو استفهامية مؤولة بالنفي، وإذا احتجنا إلى تأويلها

ZAJJAJ:v4p357/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p357/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p357/r4.claim: What the earlier people had earned did not benefit them because their works were nullified.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p552/r9.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p552/r9.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p552/r9.claim: He should explain the transient nature of worldly success to those who take pride in it.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p552/r9.anchor: if they show arrogance on their worldly successes, then he should explain their transient nature to them.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p562/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p562/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p562/r1.claim: The arrogant Quraysh repeat a claim made by earlier peoples, including Qarun, who credited wealth to his expertise; when God seized him and his treasures, neither knowledge nor strategies helped.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-6-2:p562/r1.anchor: one of them was Qārūn (Korah). It is said that whoever was afflicted with this conceited notion could not benefit

NASHR:v1p250/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p250/r2.speaker: أهل مصر وسائر بلاد المغرب
NASHR:v1p250/r2.claim: The formula أعوذ بالله العظيم من الشيطان الرجيم was used by most performance experts in Egypt and the Maghrib; it is reported from Qunbul, al-Zaynabi, Warsh routes, and Ibn Kathir, with al-Dani noting Syrian use was not transmitted to him by performance from Ibn Amir.
NASHR:v1p250/r2.anchor: ذكره الداني أيضا في جامعه عن أهل مصر وسائر بلاد المغرب، وقال إنه

NASHR:v1p250/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p250/r3.speaker: الأهوازي
NASHR:v1p250/r3.claim: The longer formula adding إن الله هو السميع العليم is transmitted from Abu ʿAmr and through routes from Abu Jaʿfar, Shayba, Nafiʿ, Madinans, Ibn Amir, al-Kisaʾi, and Hamza.
NASHR:v1p250/r3.anchor: رواه الأهوازي عن أبي عمرو، وذكره أبو معشر عن أهل مصر والمغرب

NASHR:v1p250/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p250/r4.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب ومسلم بن يسار وابن سيرين والثوري
NASHR:v1p250/r4.claim: This formula is also reported from ʿUmar, Muslim ibn Yasar, Ibn Sirin, and al-Thawri; the author read it in al-Aʿmash's reading, while al-Shanbudhi's route assimilates the two hāʾs.
NASHR:v1p250/r4.anchor: وروي عن عمر بن الخطاب ومسلم بن يسار وابن سيرين والثوري

NASHR:v1p250/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p250/r5.speaker: الخزاعي
NASHR:v1p250/r5.claim: A fourth formula, أعوذ بالله السميع العليم من الشيطان الرجيم, is transmitted by al-Khuzai from Hubayra from Hafs and by al-Hudhali from Abu ʿAdi from Warsh; al-Khuzai also recalls a Qunbul route.
NASHR:v1p250/r5.anchor: رواه الخزاعي عن هبيرة عن حفص قال: وكذا في حفظي

NASHR:v1p250/r6.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p250/r6.speaker: الهذلي
NASHR:v1p250/r6.claim: Al-Hudhali transmits a fifth formula, adding إن الله هو السميع العليم after the invocation, from al-Zaynabi from Ibn Kathir.
NASHR:v1p250/r6.anchor: رواه الهذلي عن الزينبي عن ابن كثير

ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r1.claim: The pronoun refers to the preceding sentence, innamā ūtītuhu ʿalā ʿilm; a masculine reading instead means the statement or speech.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r1.anchor: ضمير ( قالها ) لقوله تعالى : ( إنما أوتيته على علم ) لأنها كلمة أو جملة

ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r2.claim: Those before them are Qarun and his people; attributing what Qarun said to the whole group is a rational metaphor.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r2.anchor: والذين من قبلهم قارون وقومه فإنه قال ورضوا به فالإسناد من باب إسناد ما للبعض إلى الكل وهو مجاز عقلي

ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r3.claim: Another analysis makes the ظرف figurative: the saying became widespread among them, whether as the same wording or an equivalent saying.
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r3.anchor: وجوز أن يكون التجوز في الظرف فقالها الذين من قبلهم بمعنى شاعت فيهم

ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v24p12#3/r4.claim: Their accumulated earnings and worldly possessions did not benefit them.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r10.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r10.claim: Muqātil identifies the earlier speaker as Qarun, who said he had been given wealth through knowledge he possessed.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r10.anchor: قال مقاتل: يعني قارون فإنه قال

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r11.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r11.claim: Their acquired disbelief did not protect them from punishment at all.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p124#2/r11.anchor: فما أغنى عنهم الكفر من العذاب شيئا

BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r1.claim: The feminine pronoun refers to the claim I was given it on account of knowledge, understood as a word or sentence; a masculine reading is also reported.
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r1.anchor: الهاء لقوله { إنما أوتيته على علم } لأنها كلمة أو جملة

BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r2.claim: The earlier claimants are Qarun and his people, who voiced and approved his claim.
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r2.anchor: قارون وقومه فإنه قال ورضي به قومه

BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:39:50/r3.claim: Their worldly possessions and gains did not benefit them.

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r1.claim: Some colleagues successfully applied this method to Qur’anic topics in master’s and doctoral theses.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r1.anchor: وقد طبق بعض الزملاء هذا المنهج تطبيقاً ناجحاً، في موضوعات قرآنية اختاروها لرسائل الماجستير والدكتوارة

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r2.claim: She applies the method to short sūras with thematic unity, most of them Meccan and focused on foundational Islamic teachings.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r2.anchor: وأتجه بمحاولتي اليوم إلى تطبيق المنهج في تفسير

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r3.speaker: السلف الصالح
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r3.claim: The author follows the early maxim that the Qur’an explains itself, while saying exegetes have not fully realized its implications.

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r4.claim: Her inductive, inimitability-centered approach differs from conventional tafsīr and seeks to free Qur’anic meaning from imported elements and distortions.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r4.anchor: توضيح الفرق بين الطريقة المعهودة في التفسير

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r5.claim: Qur’anic scholars must first understand the text itself; comparison with the Qur’an exposes strained interpretations in tafsīr, lexicons, and rhetoric that the Qur’an rejects.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r5.anchor: مدى حاجتنا إلى فهم نصه قبل أي شيء آخر

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r6.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r6.claim: The Qur’an’s rhetoric depends on exact wording, with no substitute for a word or letter and with each vowel and tone occupying its precise place in the composition.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r6.anchor: في اللفظ لا يقوم مقامه سواه، وفي الحرف لا يؤدى معناه حرف آخر، وفي الحركة أو النبرة مكانها في النظم الباهر

BINTSHATI:v1p18/r7.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r7.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r7.claim: Whatever reception her attempt receives, she values what it has already given her in spiritual reward and in intellectual, aesthetic, and interpretive understanding through service to the Qur’an.
BINTSHATI:v1p18/r7.anchor: فحسبي الذي نلت من ثوابها، وما أجدت على مادة وذوقاً وفهماً، حين انقطعت لخدمة كتاب

BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r1.claim: Quraysh are the main intended audience, though the statement covers earlier and later peoples too; people before them made the same claim about receiving wealth through knowledge.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r1.anchor: ولما كان كفار قريش مقصودين بهذت قصدا عظيما

BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r2.claim: He links their boast to Qarun’s claim and to those who approved his state and wished for his wealth.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r2.anchor: كما قال قارون ومن رضي حاله فتمنى ماله

BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r3.claim: The earlier peoples’ repeated accumulation of wealth and status, even on a vast scale, could not benefit them or avert God’s decree.
BIQAI-FULL:v6p460/r3.anchor: أي يجددون على الاستمرار كسبه من المال والجاه وإن كان مليء السهل والجبل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r4.claim: The report that predecessors said this clarifies that the blessing was a trial: their outcome showed what followed from the boast in 39:49.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r4.anchor: جملة { قد قالها } مبينة لمضمون { هي فتنة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r5.claim: The pronoun in قالها refers to the earlier claim إنما أوتيته على علم, construed as a word or sentence; compare the phrase in al-Muʾminūn.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p36/r5.anchor: على تأويل القول بالكلمة التي هي الجملة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r1.claim: The predecessors were irreligious people of earlier generations known to God, including Qarun, whom al-Qaṣaṣ says made the same boast.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r1.anchor: ومنهم قارون وقد حكى عنه في سورة القصص

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r2.claim: Their acquisitions were their wealth, which could not protect them from punishment.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r3.claim: The فاء links the failure of their wealth to their boast; the failure implies grave harm they would seek to ransom, but could not, as the next clause explains.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v24p37/r3.anchor: فإن عدم الإغناء مشعر بأنهم حل بهم من السوء ما شأن مثله أن يتطلب صاحبه الافتداء منه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p535#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p535#2/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p535#2/r11.claim: Earlier unbelievers, including Qarun, made the same boast; their earnings and hoarded wealth did not save them, nor will they save these people.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p535#2/r11.anchor: ثم أخبر تعالى عمن سلف من الكفرة أنهم قالوا هذه المقالة كقارون وغيره، وأنهم ما أغنى عنهم كسبهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r1.claim: “They said it” refers to the boast “I was given it on the basis of knowledge.”
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r1.anchor: يعني تلك الكلمة وهي قوله إنما أوتيته على علم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r2.speaker: السدي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r2.claim: Al-Suddi says “those before them” means past nations.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r2.anchor: أحدهما أنهم الأمم الماضية قاله السدي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r3.speaker: مقاتل
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r3.claim: Muqatil says “those before them” refers to Qarun.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r4.claim: Their earnings did not spare them from punishment.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r5.claim: One view understands their earnings as disbelief.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r6.claim: A second view understands their earnings as worship of idols.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p189/r7.claim: A third view understands their earnings as wealth.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p105/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p105/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p105/r4.claim: Many earlier peoples made the same boast; their assertion was false and their amassed gains could not save them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p105/r4.anchor: أي: فما صح قولهم ولا منعهم جمعهم وما كانوا يكسبون

JISHUMI:v8p6077/r25.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r25.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r25.claim: Those who said this phrase before them are identified as earlier unbelievers.
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r25.anchor: قد قالها يعني: هذه الكلمة الذين من قبلهم قيل: من الكفار

JISHUMI:v8p6077/r26.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r26.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r26.claim: The statement recalls Qarun’s claim in 28:78 that he received his wealth through knowledge he possessed.
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r26.anchor: وقيل: أراد قارون في قوله: (أوتيته على علم عندي)

JISHUMI:v8p6077/r27.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r27.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r27.claim: Their earnings did not spare them from punishment.
JISHUMI:v8p6077/r27.anchor: يعني: لم يغن عنهم اكتسابهم شيئا من العذاب

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r1.claim: The pronoun in قالها refers to the earlier statement إنما أوتيته على علم at 28:78 and 39:49, since it is a word or sentence.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r1.anchor: راجع إلى قوله : { إنما أوتيته على علم } ( القصص : 78 )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r2.claim: A variant reads قاله, using the masculine pronoun to refer to قول or كلام.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r2.anchor: وقرىء : ( قد قاله ) على معنى القول والكلام

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r3.claim: The earlier speakers were Qarun and his people: he said this and they approved it, so the statement is attributed to them all.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r3.anchor: والذين من قبلهم : هم قارون وقومه ، حيث قال

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r4.claim: Alternatively, other people in earlier nations made the same claim.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون في الأمم الخالية آخرون قائلون مثلها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p137#2/r5.claim: The worldly goods and wealth those earlier people acquired did not avail them.

MUQATIL:39:49-50/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r5.claim: Qārūn said the same thing before Abū Ḥudhayfa, as recounted in 28:78.
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r5.anchor: قد قالها قارون فى القصص قبل أبى حذيفة

MUQATIL:39:49-50/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r6.claim: Their earnings did not save them from punishment, namely being swallowed by the earth.
MUQATIL:39:49-50/r6.anchor: { فما أغنى عنهم } من العذاب يعنى الخسف { ما كانوا يكسبون }

NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r1.claim: This refers to the claim that the favor was given because of one's own knowledge.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r1.anchor: ﴿ قد قالها ﴾ هذه المقالة وهى قوله إنما أوتيته على علم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r2.claim: One identification is Qarun and his people, who made the claim and approved of it among themselves.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r2.anchor: أى قارون وقومه حيث قال إنما أوتيته على علم عندى وقومه راضون بها فكأنهم قالوها

NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r3.claim: Alternatively, other earlier nations may have made the same claim.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون فى الأمم الخالية آخرون قائلون مثلها

NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r4.claim: Their worldly possessions and what they amassed did not benefit them.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p59/r4.anchor: من متاع الدنيا وما يجمعون منها

QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r11.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r11.claim: The feminine ending in qālahā agrees with the feminine noun kalimah, understood in the wording.
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r11.anchor: قوله تعالى: { قد قالها } أنث على تأنيث الكلمة.

QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r12.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r12.claim: Those before them are earlier unbelievers, including Qarun, who made the same claim about his knowledge.
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r12.anchor: يعني الكفار قبلهم كقارون وغيره حيث قال: «إنما أوتيته على علم عندي».

QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r13.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r13.claim: On the negative reading of mā, their wealth and children did not protect them from God’s punishment.
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r13.anchor: «ما» للجحد أي لم تغن عنهم أموالهم ولا أولادهم من عذاب الله شيئا

QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r14.claim: Alternatively, mā is interrogative: what did their wealth benefit them?
QURTUBI-FULL:39:49-52/r14.anchor: وقيل: أي فما الذي أغنى أموالهم؟ ف«ما» استفهام.
